sourceFacts.fact: Asthma can narrow airways through smooth-muscle tightening, inflammation and mucus.
Bronchiolitis causes swelling and obstructing material in small airways; routine beta-2 agonists are not recommended.
The comparison isolates bronchodilator-sensitive muscle tension and does not claim either illness has only one mechanism.

edges.meaning: relaxing muscle alone does not remove predominant swelling/material

labels: Different reasons for a narrow passage
forbiddenAnatomy: Organs, airway cross-sections, tissue layers, clinical photos, copied clinical scoring graphics

checks: Asthma label identifies muscle component, not sole mechanism.
